text: A README is previewed as GitHub draws it with `go-grip`, which renders the markdown locally and reloads the page when the file is saved. Start `go-grip -b=false -p PORT README.md` in the background. Then open `google-chrome-stable --app=http://localhost:PORT/README.md` with its own `--user-data-dir` under `tmp-claude/` in a decade scratch pane, with terminal false, so its window lands in the pane. Port 6419 is the default and is often taken.
